question: In the middle of the pavilion, taken as one third, what is made as stated?
premises: Reference is to the pavilion’s part.
One third in the middle is indicated.
inference: In the middle, taking one third of the pavilion, one makes the specified (upavedikā) as directed.
uncertainties: Exact referent of upavedikām in fused form is inferred from hint.
plain_english: In the middle, taking one third of the pavilion, having made the small altar (as specified).
